hypothesis.statement: An interface-only Control Rig route still leaves reset, range validation and QA observation to ad-hoc Blueprint implementations, risking inconsistent runtime and evidence behavior.
hypothesis.action: Make the existing required UGahyeonCharacterAnimInstance implement the facial bridge natively, own the active Control Rig map, reject invalid or conflicting updates, and expose a read-only Blueprint input for the MetaHuman face graph.
hypothesis.expectedResult: The future face Anim Blueprint only wires a stable native map into the Control Rig; transport, reset and evidence readback no longer depend on subjective Blueprint logic.

implementation.resetSemantics: explicit removal of stale named controls
implementation.preflight: face Anim Blueprint class must inherit /Script/GahyeonStage.GahyeonCharacterAnimInstance

scopeBoundary: native transport does not fabricate or edit a MetaHuman Anim Blueprint asset without UE 5.6
the Blueprint still must consume the map before its Control Rig evaluation
P36 observation and P12 deformation evidence remain required
failureHandling: reject None, non-finite and values outside 0..1
reject a curve present in active and reset sets
reject duplicate or None reset names
clear all native state when the AnimInstance uninitializes
P36 preflight rejects a face Anim Blueprint not inheriting the native bridge
decision: Use UGahyeonCharacterAnimInstance as the required parent for both body/latency semantics and MetaHuman face Control Rig input.
